checklist.title: Banner Grabbing & Service Fingerprinting
checklist.description: Identify software vendor, precise version, and OS hints.

checklist.title: Anonymous Auth & Permissions Check
checklist.description: Verify anonymous access (`anonymous:anonymous` or `ftp:ftp`) and test read/write privileges.

checklist.title: Recursive Directory & Hidden File Listing
checklist.description: Recursively download files and check for hidden dotfiles (`.bak`, `.config`, SSH keys).

checklist.title: Passive vs. Active Mode & Bounce Scanning
checklist.description: Determine host firewall behavior with PASV/PORT commands and test FTP bounce support.

checklist.title: Credential Brute-Forcing
checklist.description: Test default passwords and spray common user lists if anonymous access is disabled.

checklist.title: Known Vulnerability Lookup
checklist.description: Check Exploit-DB and NSE vulnerability scripts against the exact FTP server version.
